overview: Black strikes at once in the centre with 3...e5 and wants to meet 4.dxe5 with 4...Ng4, attacking the e5 pawn and using quick development. White can take and try to hold the pawn, or play Nf3 and Bg2. Strong players treat the gambit as risky for Black.

white_ideas.idea: Win and keep the pawn with dxe5 and Bf4 or Nf3
Develop with Nc3 and Bg2 to cover the king

black_ideas.idea: Win the pawn back with ...Ng4 and ...Nc6

typical_structures.structure: Open centre after dxe5, Black with a lead in development

character.notes: Black gives a pawn and attacks at once, so tactics decide.

gambit.notes: White can take on e5 and keep the pawn.

sublines_that_differ.name: 4.Nf3 and 4.Bg2
sublines_that_differ.how: White ignores the gambit and plays a quiet developing move, which Black can answer in various ways.

plans.reason: Black wants development and activity for the pawn.
